name: Ruby Amulet / four live sparse effect
notes: Activate the actual own Arena Ruby UID5 as an Instant, destroy it as the activation cost, and spend no AP/resources. The mandatory Watery Grave trigger is above original abilityUID6 as triggerUID7. Four actual passes resolve the trigger first: physical UID5 remains in its own Graveyard and becomes FaceDown1, with resources still0. Another four actual passes resolve the original ability for exactly+2resources. AP remains1 and all four health totals remain20. Both virtual layers disappear; only physical Ruby5 is in Graveyard. One physical Ruby only obeys the printed one-per-constructed-deck restriction. This fixture begins with an existing Arena item; playing it as an Action and other Watery interactions are not covered. Mandatory destruction/Watery handling is included rather than omitted. All four real players hold priority/all11 shortcut windows false. Each manual clockwise pass is followed by its own checkpoint. Source physicalUID/ownership and all four final health/economy/queues/zones are checked. No whole diagnostic container or cached defense oracle. One representative only; no group/sibling/support-token completion claim.
